column1: # tests/TEST_WIRING.tsv -- every test file is WIRED or declared MANUAL. No third state.
# 171 test files in tests/. Only 40 were referenced anywhere executable.
# 131 -- 76% -- ran nowhere: not in .github, not in a Makefile, not in
# scripts/, not in bin/. Among them the daemon signature gate, both red-team
# supply-chain/TeamID pin tests, the walk-away input-leak test, three consent
# tests, two GDPR tests, and test_makefile_app_path_default.sh, which was
# shipped four days earlier as a guard and had never run.
# Spot-checked: several of the unwired PASS. This is not 131 broken tests. It
# is worse in a quieter way -- nothing runs them, so nobody learns when one
# STOPS passing. A test that runs only when someone remembers is documentation.
# CONTROLS behind that count, because one bulk runner would void it:
#   no tests/* glob, no `for .. in tests/`, no `find tests` anywhere;
#   scripts/run_all_cut_gates.sh names its tests explicitly -- 3 of them;
#   a first pass over .github + Makefiles alone said 133, widening to scripts/
#   and bin/ gave 131. The corrected figure is the one recorded here.
# FORMAT   <file><TAB><status><TAB><where it runs, or the reason it cannot>
#   WIRED         runs automatically. Third column names the runner, and that
#                 column is MEASURED by tests/verify_test_wiring.sh, not typed.
#   MANUAL        deliberately not automated. Columns 3-5 are REQUIRED:
#                 A MANUAL row with no reason, no declarer, no date, or a date
#                 in the past is rejected. A MANUAL row that something DOES run
#                 is rejected too: the declaration has gone stale.
#   UNCLASSIFIED  not yet decided. The gate FAILS on these. They are listed
#                 rather than omitted so the backlog is visible and finite.
# UNCLASSIFIED IS NOT A PASS, and the count below is expected to be red until
# each row is ruled. Do not bulk-convert them to MANUAL to go green: that
# converts this file into the defect it exists to record.
# WHY MANUAL EXPIRES (Archie, 2026-08-13). CM051 cut-deferrals.yaml still
# carried a deferral for #606 after #606 had merged, and is_deferred() ran
# before branch_landed(), so the gate printed DEFERRED over shipping work. A
# permanent opt-out with a reason field and no review date is that same bug
# with better manners. Every MANUAL row comes up for re-confirmation.
# generated 2026-08-13 -- WIRED rows measured, others need a human call.
# CORRECTED 2026-08-13, twice, and both corrections are the point.
# (a) test_makefile_app_path_default.sh was recorded WIRED. Its only mention
#     outside tests/ was a COMMENT in gui/Makefile. I counted a comment as CI
#     wiring in a manifest whose entire purpose is to stop exactly that, on the
#     same day I recorded doing it to a different gate. It is now genuinely
#     THE HEADLINE NUMBER ABOVE INHERITED THAT ERROR. "40 referenced, 131 ran
#     nowhere" counted this file as referenced. Measured coverage at discovery
#     was 38 of 171 (22%), not 40 of 171 (23%) -- the error ran in the
#     direction of over-stating coverage, which is the direction that matters.
#     The prose above is left as first written so the drift is legible.
# (b) The gate matched the extensionless STEM, so test_install_gui_contract.py
#     was satisfied by a reference to test_install_gui_contract_negatives.py.
#     Both are referenced today, so nothing was mis-reported -- but delete one
#     runner and the row would still have read as covered. Matching is now on
#     the stem with an identifier boundary on both sides, which also catches
#     the legitimate `python3 -m unittest tests.test_foo` form that a
# ---- UNCLASSIFIED (132) -- each needs a WIRED or MANUAL ruling ----
